pages.heading: Pale traces
pages.body:
Some patches of ground hold their colour poorly. The scraps found there are cold, light, and slow to crumble. There is no movement in them.

Look for pale traces on natural ground and harvest them for dormant flakes. Cold tissue is safe to handle. If nearby ground has been searched, try newly explored country.

pages.heading: A place to begin
pages.body:
A book and one flake make a field journal. A replacement copy will keep the discoveries you have already made.

Keep several flakes for instruments. Four form a Dormant Knot; the recipes here show how to build a Stillness Resonator and an Essence Condenser. Place those machines next to each other. Their first sample should be a single flake.

pages.heading: The first charter
pages.body:
The Overworld is sheltered by what these notes call the Stillness. Ordinary collection does not weaken it; keeping your home quiet requires no maintenance.

Refine essence, build a terminal, and begin with Field Survey. Follow the offered training charters. Their instructions are worth learning before taking equipment farther afield.

bloom.title: II. Folded bark

pages.heading: The shutters
pages.body:
The plates resemble dry bark until they move. One opens, then another; a narrow amber lining appears between them. The surrounding pale skin continues over materials that were never wood.

These notes use the name Shutter Bloom. The name describes its shape. It does not explain what is doing the growing.

pages.heading: Work from the edge
pages.body:
The surface growth spreads from a nearby bloom. Removing that source stops its colony and leaves supported tissue dormant. Break the tissue itself for flakes; tearing away its support leaves no useful harvest.

Living tissue and infected creatures transmit infection through contact. Standing nearby is not enough. Leave yourself a clear place to step before cutting a sample.

bloom.unlock_hint: Approach a living growth with pale shutters and an amber lining.

essence.title: III. A useful residue

pages.heading: A held movement
pages.body:
A knot remains still on the bench, yet the resonator draws something from it. The needle settles only while the surrounding field is quiet. Resonance is the workshop name for that difference.

A Stillness Resonator supplies 20 Resonance per tick on sheltered or liberated ground. Nearby instruments share the same field; leave seven blocks between their centres for separate output.

pages.heading: The condenser
pages.body:
Place a flake in the left slot and supply power. The right slot receives the refined essence. One flake needs 4000 Resonance and ten seconds of powered work.

The resonator does not burn its knot. Hoppers can feed the condenser and collect its result. Compatible FE equipment can supply power through the same connection. A redstone signal pauses a generator.

pages.heading: Keep a sample
pages.body:
The refined material holds together better than the scrap it came from. Copper, glass and a little essence are enough for the next instruments.

The crafting pages record the preparations currently understood. Save a few samples before committing the whole stock to one project.

essence.unlock_hint: Collect a dormant flake or refine your first essence.

terminal.title: IV. The threshold

pages.heading: An address
pages.body:
The terminal fixes a route through country it has not made safe. A successful deployment is an address and a way back, not a promise about the journey.

Choose a charter, difficulty and route length. Read its requirements, objectives and rewards before starting. A refused route does not deploy markers or take its entry payment.

pages.heading: Before entry
pages.body:
The portal opens above the terminal. Take food, a weapon and room for cargo. Entering issues the route compass.

Others may join through the portal until the first checkpoint seals the party. Complete the offered survey before expecting the terminal to arrange journeys farther from home.

terminal.unlock_hint: Use a terminal and examine the charters it can offer.

wayfinding.title: V. The compass

pages.heading: Reading the ember
pages.body:
The thorn follows the next marker. The ember gives the part of the reading the needle cannot: height. Above the needle means higher ground; below it means a lower passage.

Hold use to take a steadier reading. The ember and chime rise or fall together. Release when you have your bearing.

pages.heading: A bearing, not a path
pages.body:
A needle pointing into a cliff has not found a tunnel. Look for a route around or beneath it; the instrument cannot choose your footing.

After the checkpoints, it points to extraction. The terminal recalls this compass when the expedition ends. Keep your own equipment separate from what the charter lends.

wayfinding.unlock_hint: Enter an expedition portal and take its issued compass.

checkpoints.title: VI. Settled marks

pages.heading: Settle the mark
pages.body:
Use checkpoints in the order the compass gives. The first closes the party to new arrivals.

Each settled mark banks part of the guaranteed reward for every member. Those secured tokens survive a failed expedition. Extraction settles the remainder and any earned bonuses.

Activation can draw company. Leave yourself room to move before touching the instrument.

pages.heading: An unfinished route
pages.body:
Death removes a member from the expedition; losing the last member ends it. Already banked tokens remain yours.

Disconnecting leaves an unfinished route for later recovery, provided its markers still exist. Reaching the final checkpoint is not extraction. Follow the compass back to the exit and use it.

checkpoints.unlock_hint: Use a checkpoint rather than merely passing its light.

cargo.title: VII. Sealed cargo

pages.heading: The seal
pages.body:
The parcel is warmer at the binding than at its centre. Its seal agrees with the mark on this charter.

A recovery objective issues cargo at its named checkpoint. Keep it with you and bring it to extraction. A parcel from another journey cannot settle this contract.

pages.heading: Bring the object
pages.body:
A written record is no substitute for the cargo. If it is lost, retrieve it before attempting to leave. A required recovery remains unfinished without the object.

Successful extraction takes the sealed parcel and records its delivery. Loose samples and equipment are yours to bring home.

cargo.unlock_hint: Reach a recovery site and take possession of its sealed parcel.

defense.title: VIII. Hold the line

pages.heading: An audible machine
pages.body:
The device is easier to hear once the surrounding movement stops. It seldom stays quiet for long.

A defense charter deploys the machine beside its checkpoint. Keep it intact until the countdown ends. Watch the approaches as well as its remaining integrity; your own blows can damage it.

pages.heading: Before the first wave
pages.body:
Make room to circle the device and keep a clear way back. Attackers can reach it while you are occupied elsewhere.

Losing a required device fails the expedition. An optional defense can be lost without ending the route, but its bonus is gone. Read which kind you have before starting.

defense.unlock_hint: Activate a checkpoint whose charter calls for a deployed device.

blood.title: IX. A sealed sample

pages.heading: Take a fresh reading
pages.body:
Old samples remain sealed and old readings remain old. The kit describes the patient at the moment of collection.

Craft it from a glass bottle, iron, copper and a dormant flake. Sneak-use draws a nonlethal sample costing one heart. Use normally to read its infection level, stage and age. Draw again to check a change.

pages.heading: After contact
pages.body:
Exposure begins with contact with living tissue or an infected body. Some affected creatures shake even while standing still; several may turn towards the same disturbance.

Early exposure can subside once contact stops. A Disruption Charm in the offhand or a Curios charm slot blocks new infection. It does not erase a dose already present. Give recovery time, then check a fresh sample.

blood.unlock_hint: Draw a sample with an assay kit, or notice the first effects of exposure.

pressure.title: X. Being noticed

pages.heading: The answering country
pages.body:
A sound behind you is ordinary. Several creatures arriving from different directions deserve more attention.

The bar at the top of the screen shows how closely the country is attending to you. Its next mark is a warning. Prepare to move before it is reached. A charm protects against infection; it does not conceal your presence.

pages.heading: Buy time
pages.body:
Settling a checkpoint lowers attention. Leaving the dimension lets it subside. Neither death nor logging out wipes the record of your stay.

Repeated successful operations establish a foothold and slow its rise. A liberated dimension no longer pursues you this way. Home is sheltered by the Stillness unless a local field has deliberately been opened.

pressure.unlock_hint: Remain in affected country long enough for it to answer your presence.

extraction.title: XI. Bring it home

pages.heading: Settle the charter
pages.body:
A route is only a line on the map until somebody returns along it.

Use the extraction marker after every checkpoint and required objective is complete. Bring any sealed cargo with you. The party returns home, the delivery settles, and earned rewards are credited. Optional work and timely completion can add bonuses.

pages.heading: What can be used again
pages.body:
Samples become equipment, and a completed charter becomes a record the terminal can recognise. Check its offerings after a return. Some work needs several forms of preparation.

Tokens can be exchanged with /expeditions redeem; the available pool follows the dimension you stand in. Put useful supplies aside before spending the whole balance on another contract.

extraction.unlock_hint: Use extraction after the charter's required work is complete.

guardian.title: XII. At the last marker

pages.heading: The bound guardian
pages.body:
The wood moves around an empty space. The amber inside becomes easier to see just before a strike.

This charter names a particular guardian. Defeat that creature and then extract to settle the confrontation. Reaching the exit while it lives will not finish the work. A different creature killed elsewhere is not proof.

pages.heading: Watch the ground
pages.body:
Raised arms and an ember circle give warning of a sweep. Leave the marked ground before it lands. The exposed core is vulnerable during the windup, if you can attack and still get clear.

As the core brightens, smaller warning marks can appear beneath its target. Keep moving out of them. Use the pause after a strike to regain space.

guardian.unlock_hint: Follow a confrontation charter until its final mark answers.

liberation.title: XIII. After silence

pages.heading: What has stopped
pages.body:
The ordinary sounds remain. What is missing takes longer to notice.

An accepted guardian victory followed by extraction liberates the dimension for everyone. New colonies stop taking hold, growth ceases, and the pursuit clock falls quiet. Native creatures and ordinary hazards remain. Repeated surveys alone do not produce this change.

pages.heading: A quiet remnant
pages.body:
A core held against a terminal here can retain something of the quiet. It is a useful result, though these notes offer no explanation for why it travels.

Craft an Unattuned Severance Core and use it on a terminal in the liberated dimension. Install the attuned core in a Severance Cradle for 120 Resonance per tick without fuel. The terminal must recognise the liberation record; a marked map is not enough.

liberation.unlock_hint: Return to country whose campaign has been brought to a close.

preparation.title: XIV. Things brought back

pages.heading: Choose the experiment
pages.body:
A recovered bloom folds while it is carried. Behind glass, the shutters can be coaxed into their old movement.

One specimen can become a Bloom Engine, a Field Ward or a Heartglass Lens. Each recipe consumes the specimen. Decide what the next journey lacks before committing it.

pages.heading: A contained source
pages.body:
The Bloom Engine holds its specimen inside a closed chamber. Supply essence to keep it working. One essence supports thirty running seconds at up to 80 Resonance per tick. A full bank pauses consumption; an unfed chamber goes quiet.

This is a workshop source. Opening the surrounding field is a separate experiment.

pages.heading: Carry a reserve
pages.body:
A Resonance Cell holds 16000 Resonance and starts empty. Sneak-use a generator to charge it; use a receiver normally to supply it. Compatible FE chargers also work.

Carry a charged cell rather than assuming there will be a working workshop at the far end.

pages.heading: A quiet camp
pages.body:
Place a Field Ward and use a cell holding at least 4000 Resonance. It holds attention steady within eight blocks for two minutes. Check the remaining time with an empty hand.

It does not lower attention already gathered, stop an existing hunt, or block infection. Breaking the ward loses its remaining charge. Its two minutes pass even if you leave it behind.

pages.heading: Measure a bearing
pages.body:
Carry a Heartglass Lens and a charged cell, then finish a reading with the expedition compass. A measurement costs 200 Resonance and gives horizontal distance and signed height.

Without that charge, the ordinary needle and elevation ember still work. The lens belongs to you after extraction.

pages.heading: Opening the field
pages.body:
For a controlled experiment, sneak-use an attunement sigil on a condenser holding at least 4000 Resonance. The open field reaches twenty-four blocks and consumes 20 Resonance per tick; refining pauses.

Live growth can operate inside it. A dormant resonator there loses the quiet field it draws from, so supply power from outside or use a contained engine. Use the sigil again to close the field. Power loss also restores the Stillness.

preparation.unlock_hint: Recover a living Shutter Bloom, or obtain an instrument made from one.
